from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    mc=None
    for j in range(w):
        col={g[i][j] for i in range(h)}
        if len(col)==1:
            v=next(iter(col))
            if all(g[i][jj]!=v for i in range(h) for jj in range(w) if jj!=j):
                mc=j; break
    marker=g[0][mc]
    L=[r[:mc] for r in g]; R=[r[mc+1:] for r in g]
    cl=Counter(x for r in L for x in r); cr=Counter(x for r in R for x in r)
    nl=cl.most_common()[-1][0]                 # left noise (minority)
    rbg=cr.most_common(1)[0][0]                # right bg
    rn=[c for c in cr if c not in (rbg,0)]     # right noise (nonzero minority)

    bg=(nl+rn)%10
    noise=(rbg+marker)%10
    return [[noise if (R[i][j]!=0 and (L[i][j]==nl or R[i][j]==rn)) else bg for j in range(len(L[0]))] for i in range(h)]
